correctness.rationale: All empty vertices are exactly a matching of K_n. Each chosen bad color-absence event forces \(2(n-2)\) singleton labels; union over k disjoint matching edges has precisely \(U_k=2k(n-k-1)\) edges. Different forbidden-color families have empty intersections via the four interpair connecting edges. Inclusion-exclusion gives all coefficients with no omitted cases. A split-part 2-color construction attains the vertex-cover lower bound, and extracting the lowest coefficient gives the exact optimizer count. Definition-level exhaustive tests through \(n=5\) and minimum checks through \(n=6\) agree, while the combinatorial proof supplies the infinite quantifier.

value.rationale: The exact weight enumerator is a natural full-classification invariant on the canonical infinite family of triangular graphs. A matching expansion plus nontrivial color-deficiency overlaps supplies every coefficient and closed optimum multiplicities; it reveals exponentially dense admissible optimum bicolorings for a fixed empty maximum matching. The count does not follow from the generic vertex-cover lower bound and is not an arbitrary finite slice.
